service.name: Classical strings
service.serviceType: String quartet, trio, duo and solo violinist for weddings, galas, dinners and memorials
service.description: Classical strings for private and corporate events: a solo violinist, a string duo, a string trio or a string quartet of two violins, viola and cello, playing classical processionals, hymns and popular songs arranged for strings, for wedding ceremonies, cocktail hours, galas, client dinners, anniversaries and memorial services across Denver, the Front Range and the Colorado mountain towns.

faqs.q: What does a string quartet cost for a wedding in Denver?
faqs.a: A Denver wedding guide puts a classical string duo or trio for a ceremony or cocktail hour at {{market:denver_strings}}, and a full quartet sits above that. That's the market's figure. Signet doesn't publish prices, so send us the date, the venue and the size you're picturing and we'll price that night.

faqs.q: How much space does a string quartet need?
faqs.a: A level spot about ten feet across and eight deep, four seats without arms, and shade or cover outdoors. The musicians bring their own stands and music, and indoors nothing is plugged in. One violinist fits in a corner about four feet across.

faqs.q: Can a string quartet play outdoors?
faqs.a: Yes, with shade, cover from rain and level ground, because a violin can't sit in direct sun or get wet. Cold matters too, since strings drift and fingers slow down once the temperature drops into the fifties, so for a mountain ceremony we agree a plan for moving under cover with you ahead of time.

faqs.q: How loud is a string quartet?
faqs.a: About as loud as a conversation at the next table. Indoors it plays a prelude, a processional and a cocktail hour with nothing plugged in, and the front table keeps talking. Outdoors, or in a hall where the back has to hear the officiant, a small sound system on one standard outlet carries the strings and a microphone, and the musicians set the level to the space.

faqs.q: Can you play a song that isn't on the list?
faqs.a: Yes. Custom arrangements are part of the booking, so a song that isn't on the list can be written out for the size you book, one violin or four. Send the title with the date, and a recording of the version you mean if there's more than one.

faqs.q: Who plays a classical strings booking?
faqs.a: Working string players from our roster, and we name them to you when the contract is written. You book the size, one violinist to the quartet, and the same players cover the ceremony and the cocktail hour.
